comments.author: olalonde
comments.story: New Orleans will use AI to answer 911 calls instead of a human
comments.why: Example of coded language in emergency calls
comments.text: People also sometimes talk in coded language to avoid alerting suspects. I'm not sure LLMs would be capable to pick up on that. Example: [VIDEO]

comments.author: DoreenMichele
comments.story: Teen rescued after showing domestic violence hand signal known on TikTok
comments.why: Woman ordering pizza to give address to dispatcher
comments.text: Your comment reminds me of a video clip I saw where someone dialed 911 and proceeded to "order a pizza," thus giving them her address. She got lucky and the dispatcher was fairly quick to figure it out and didn't hang up on her. [VIDEO]
